children: On Saturday, four-time NBA champion and four-time Olympic medalist
James posted a 14-second video on X showing him exiting an elevator at “Polymarket HQ,” with floor buttons labeled sports, politics, crypto, economy, weather and technology.
The caption read, “Welcome to Polymarket HQ. Coming soon.”
Welcome to Polymarket HQ. Coming soon. 👀
Athletes Increasingly Bet on Prediction Markets
The deal adds the future Hall of Famer to a growing roster of athletes entering the sector.

Polymarket, an online prediction market where users trade shares on the outcomes of real-world events such as elections, sports and economic data, positions itself as the world’s biggest prediction market.
has also promoted Polymarket on Instagram.

James’ addition to the prediction market sector reflects an upward trend of star athletes taking on various roles in the industry. This partnership would make him the first NBA athlete to sign an individual partnership with Polymarket.
James’ exact role hasn’t been disclosed. Polymarket responded to his post with, “Thanks for stopping by our HQ.”
A company spokesperson said more details would follow Tuesday, adding the firm hopes to leverage “James’ love for the sport” as football season nears, according to The Athletic report.
